title: Screener board index
description: The single canonical machine-readable state of the screener pipeline board, at screener/board/index.json. Rebuilt deterministically by scripts/update_board_index.py from the ledger + run folders + inbox. The cockpit board reads THIS file (plus live in-memory runs) — it never crawls agent prose.

triage_score.description: Composite PRIORITY 0–100 (absent on manual-sweep rows): the cheap Groq materiality read, re-ranked deterministically by §4 source tier (filing>news), company-vs-broad scope, strongest event, size and recency (news/rank.ts). Orders + bands the inbox. NOT the authoritative gauntlet score.

materiality_pre_score.description: The RAW Groq title-only materiality read, before the composite re-rank — kept for transparency.

rank_factors.description: Breakdown of the composite triage_score: { materiality, source_tier, scope, event, size, recency, scope_id, source_tier_id } (news/rank.ts).

event_types.description: Theme tags from the gauntlet's event-type vocabulary (mna, regulatory, …).

companies.description: Companies the cheap scanner GUESSED from the headline alone — never verified extraction.

size_bucket.description: Guessed size of the main company: mega / large / mid / small / unknown (or empty on manual rows).

dismissed.description: Human state: hidden from the Inbox lane via the cockpit; restorable.

signals.description: Every processed signal (from the events ledger), newest first.

status.description: PROMOTE / PARK / LOG / suppress / watchlist_no_source / in_gauntlet / thesis statuses once Phase 1 ran.

theses.description: Every thesis record (from screener/ledger/theses/), newest first.

effective_status.description: Where the board shows this thesis: the engine's status unless a human moved it (overrides.ndjson, latest wins). The engine's own `status` is never altered.

override.description: The active human move, when one exists.

from_status.description: The engine status at move time — staleness detection anchor.

override_stale.description: True when the engine re-ran and changed its status AFTER the human move — surfaced in the UI, never silently resolved.

integrity_review.description: thesis-integrity's verdict on this thesis, additively patched onto the ledger copy by scripts/screener_patch_integrity_review.py (frameworks/screener/SCREENER_PIPELINE.md). Null until the gate has reviewed this thesis. A terminal routing here (without a later human override) is why effective_status reads watchlist_integrity_downgrade/broken instead of the locked provisional/full_machine status.

gap_read.description: News-impact sizing verdict (NEWS_IMPACT.md): priced | underpriced_candidate | re_rate_to_judge | not_applicable. Null when no sizing.

implied_move_pct.description: The move the event justifies on fundamentals, in percent.

observed_move_pct.description: The dated stock reaction to the news, in percent.

conviction.description: Phase 3 live-book snapshot (engine-owned, separate from the human override). Full shape: frameworks/screener/conviction.schema.json. Null when the conviction loop has not seeded this thesis.

upgrade_velocity.description: Edge points / 30 days (signed) — the 'rate of upgrade'.

ideas.description: The PM skim's surfaced ideas (news/ideas) — a cheap free-LLM pass over ranked wire and actionable-theme inputs that names the best 1-2 tradable stock ideas (ticker · side · one plain reason · a pre-edge read), feeding the paid gauntlet on a click. Best-first (trade score, then materiality); a decayed idea sorts last and carries stale:true. Optional (absent on an engine build before this feature) — the cockpit fails closed when it's missing.

idea_id.description: IDEA-<sha256-12 of ticker|direction> — stable identity; a re-surfacing of the same directional call updates in place.

idea_version.description: Immutable surfaced-idea-version/v2 canonical-JSON hash (legacy wire snapshots may retain the prior recipe).

exchange.description: The model's guess; UNVERIFIED (no dated listing check at surface tier).

pair_with.description: The other leg's ticker when direction is pair. New lineage snapshots persist it only after independent directory verification and bind its normalized value into the immutable idea version; field-absent legacy lineage may predate that guarantee.

reason.description: One plain-English sentence stating the mechanism (§21).

why_now.description: Why it's live now — the dated catalyst, or 'timing unproven' (§17).

conviction.description: 0–100 PRE-EDGE proxy — NOT the locked 0.40/0.30/0.30 edge score.

conviction_basis.description: Hard label so the surface read can never masquerade as the locked edge score (§7).

thesis_type.description: §14 classification — flags a macro/commodity/policy bet wearing a ticker.

origin_type.description: How the surfaced idea entered the skim. Optional only for deploy-compatible legacy snapshots; when present, source_themes is present too.

source_themes.description: Exact theme revisions behind this idea. Empty for wire origin; non-empty for theme/mixed, where every ref must carry evidence_event_ids. Legacy means both source_themes and origin_type are absent.

evidence_event_ids.description: Exact wire events from this theme revision that contributed to the idea; new theme/mixed lineage requires the distinct why-now trigger plus structural expression proof.

why_now_event_id.description: The supporting event bound to this revision's why-now claim; present on new lineage and included in source_event_ids when the theme seeds an idea.

source_event_ids.description: EVT-* — the join key back to the wire events that produced this idea.

primary_source_event_id.description: Exact member of source_event_ids recomputed from source_headline + source_url. It supplies the promotion launch source.

source_url.description: The primary source URL — so a promotion's SIG_ID byte-matches the wire event.

source_name.description: The primary source publisher — Gate 0 checks it on promotion.

materiality_max.description: Top triage_score among the source events.

newest_source_at.description: ISO of the freshest contributing event — drives freshness + decay.

prior_coverage.description: Free (no-LLM) read of whether the engine already looked at this ticker.

decay_at.description: Shelf-life expiry — the board marks the idea stale past this by a pure date compare.

status.description: promoted once escalated to the paid gauntlet.

feedback.description: The human's latest 👍/👎 on this idea (self-grading loop); null = no vote. From screener/ledger/ideas_feedback.ndjson, last vote per idea wins.

stale.description: Derived at build time: decay_at is in the past.

ideas_scorecard.description: The PM skim's HONEST track record (no price, no P&L): how many ideas it surfaced, how many the human ran, how the DEEP machine graded the ones that were run, and the 👍/👎 tally. The UI refuses to quote a confirmation rate until `resolved` clears a small floor.

surfaced_total.description: Ideas currently tracked (live + recently cooled + all promoted).

promoted_total.description: Ideas the human ran through the paid gauntlet.

machine_confirmed.description: Promoted ideas whose signal reached provisional / full_machine — the deep machine agreed with the skim.

machine_passed.description: Promoted ideas the deep machine passed on (watchlist / logged / parked).

machine_pending.description: Promoted ideas whose gauntlet run has not resolved yet.

resolved.description: machine_confirmed + machine_passed — the denominator for a confirmation rate.

counts.description: Funnel totals for the board header.

news_seen_today.description: Autonomous ingester: on-list items triaged today.

news_picked_today.description: Autonomous ingester: items scored worth inboxing today.

news_dropped_today.description: Autonomous ingester: items triaged but not inboxed today.

book_momentum.description: Phase 3 live book: is the desk's set of live ideas upgrading on balance? The headline 'upgrading at +N/30d' number.

mean_upgrade_velocity.description: Mean edge-points / 30 days across live theses.
